STORY AB#116 [User Story, New] Customer checks the order totals before buying
Acceptance criteria:
  • AC-1: The overview lists the products in the cart with their prices. 
  • AC-2: The item total equals the sum of the listed prices. 
  • AC-3: The total equals the item total plus the tax shown.
Description:
  As a customer I want to see what I will pay before I confirm.
EXISTING TEST CASES: none linked to this story yet.

PARENT #107 [Epic] Cart and checkout
  The cart and the three checkout steps: information, overview and completion.

OTHER STORIES UNDER THIS EPIC — behaviour that belongs to one of these is NOT this story's to test. If an open bug below is about one of them, say so and leave it:
  #114 [User Story] Customer reviews the cart
    • AC-1: The cart lists each added product with its quantity, name and price. 
    • AC-2: Removing a product in the cart takes it off the list and lowers the cart badge. 
    • AC-3: Continue shopping returns to the product list with the cart unchanged.
  #115 [User Story] Customer gives their details at checkout
    • AC-1: Continuing with first name, last name and postal code filled in goes to the order overview. 
    • AC-2: Continuing with the first name empty shows an error saying the first name is required; the same holds for the last name and the postal code. 
    • AC-3: Cancel returns to the cart with the cart unchanged.
  #117 [User Story] Customer completes the order
    • AC-1: Finishing from the overview shows a thank-you message for the order. 
    • AC-2: After the order the cart is empty and the cart badge is not shown. 
    • AC-3: Back home from the confirmation returns to the product list.
  #120 [User Story] Every customer can finish an order
    • AC-1: A customer who fills in first name, last name and postal code reaches the overview with those details accepted. 
    • AC-2: Finishing from the overview shows the thank-you message, whichever demo customer is signed in.

CHILD ITEMS: none linked to this story.

COMMENTS — 1 from people:
  - Vijay Javvadi javvadi:
    Product owner: tax is shown as its own line and is part of the total; testing the tax rate itself is out of scope.

OPEN BUGS — 2 filed by people.
Each state asks something different of you:
  #121 [Active] Problem user sees the same picture for every product
    ACTIVE — known broken and being worked. A test for it is EXPECTED to fail; that failure is not a new defect and must not become a bug.
    Steps: sign in as the problem user and look at the product list. 
    EXPECTED: each product shows its own picture. 
    ACTUAL: every product shows the same picture. 
    Filed by a person, not by attestqa.
  #122 [Active] Error user cannot finish an order
    ACTIVE — known broken and being worked. A test for it is EXPECTED to fail; that failure is not a new defect and must not become a bug.
    Steps: sign in as the error user, add a product, check out, fill in the details, finish. 
    EXPECTED: the thank-you message. 
    ACTUAL: the order is not completed (the exact symptom to be confirmed on the day: a field that does not take input, or Finish that does nothing). 
    Filed by a person, not by attestqa.
